```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# Function to plot personality trait by ussage and separate by Legal/Illegal category
plot_personality_trait <- function(data, trait, fill_colors = c("#BCB8F0", "#E9006D")) {
  ggplot(data, aes_string(x = "Usage", y = trait, fill = "Usage")) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    facet_wrap(~Category) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors) +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = paste(trait, "Score"),
      fill = "Usage"
    ) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    theme_classic()
}

# Create the plots
neuro_boxplot <- plot_personality_trait(ddata_long, "Neuroticism")
extraversion_boxplot <- plot_personality_trait(ddata_long, "Extraversion")
openness_boxplot <- plot_personality_trait(ddata_long, "Openness")
agreeableness_boxplot <- plot_personality_trait(ddata_long, "Agreeableness")
consc_boxplot <- plot_personality_trait(ddata_long, "Conscientiousness")
impulsivity_boxplot <- plot_personality_trait(ddata_long, "Impulsivity")
SS_boxplot <- plot_personality_trait(ddata_long, "Sensation_Seeking")


# Arrange the plots in a 2x2 grid
combined_plot <- ggarrange(neuro_boxplot, extraversion_boxplot, openness_boxplot, agreeableness_boxplot,
                           ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
combined_plot2 <- ggarrange(consc_boxplot, impulsivity_boxplot, SS_boxplot,
          ncol = 2, nrow = 2)


# Add one common title above all plots
annotate_figure(combined_plot, 
                top = text_grob("Personality Traits by Drug Use for Legal and Illegal Drugs",
                                face = "bold", size = 14))

annotate_figure(combined_plot2, 
                top = text_grob("Personality Traits by Drug Use for Legal and Illegal Drugs",
                                face = "bold", size = 14))
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)

#data
ddata <- read_excel(
  "CLEANING DATA DRUG.xlsx",
  sheet = "DATA_FINAL_ANALYSIS"
)

# age + ed
ddata$AgeEdu <- paste(ddata$Age_Group, ddata$Education_Level_Final, sep = " / ")

# drugs
keep_drugs <- c(
  "Caffeine_Use",
  "Nicotine_Use",
  "Alcohol_Use",
  "Chocolate_Use",
  "Cocaine_Use",
  "Ketamine_Use",
  "Heroin_Use",
  "LSD_Use"
)

d_long <- ddata %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(keep_drugs),
    names_to  = "Drug",
    values_to = "Use"
  ) %>%
  filter(Use == "User")

#clean labels 
pretty_drug_labels <- function(mat) {
  labs <- colnames(mat)
  labs <- gsub("_Use$", "", labs)
  labs <- gsub("_", " ", labs)
  labs
}

# color
overall_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "#b38bff"))(50)   
male_colors    <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "#6bb6ff"))(50)  
female_colors  <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "#ff8ac6"))(50)   


# overall heatmap
all_tab <- d_long %>%
  count(AgeEdu, Drug, name = "Users") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Drug,
    values_from = Users,
    values_fill = 0
  )

mat_all <- as.matrix(all_tab[, -1])
rownames(mat_all) <- all_tab$AgeEdu

pheatmap(
  mat_all,
  main = "Drug Use by Age + Education (All)",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  labels_col = pretty_drug_labels(mat_all),
  color = overall_colors
)

#male heatmap 
male_tab <- d_long %>%
  filter(Gender == "Male") %>%
  count(AgeEdu, Drug, name = "Users") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Drug,
    values_from = Users,
    values_fill = 0
  )

mat_male <- as.matrix(male_tab[, -1])
rownames(mat_male) <- male_tab$AgeEdu

pheatmap(
  mat_male,
  main = "Drug Use by Age + Education (Male)",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  labels_col = pretty_drug_labels(mat_male),
  color = male_colors
)

# female heatmap
female_tab <- d_long %>%
  filter(Gender == "Female") %>%
  count(AgeEdu, Drug, name = "Users") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Drug,
    values_from = Users,
    values_fill = 0
  )

mat_female <- as.matrix(female_tab[, -1])
rownames(mat_female) <- female_tab$AgeEdu

pheatmap(
  mat_female,
  main = "Drug Use by Age + Education (Female)",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  labels_col = pretty_drug_labels(mat_female),
  color = female_colors
)

```
```{r}
# drug categories
legal_drugs <- c("Alcohol_Use", "Caffeine_Use", "Chocolate_Use", "Nicotine_Use")
illegal_drugs <- c("Cocaine_Use", "Heroin_Use", "LSD_Use", "Ketamine_Use")
all_drugs <- c(legal_drugs, illegal_drugs)



# reshape data to long format
data_long <- ddata %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(all_drugs),
    names_to = "Drug",
    values_to = "Use_Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Drug = str_remove(Drug, "_Use")  # remove "_Use" from drug names
  )



# reorder education
data_long$Education_Level_Final <- factor(
  data_long$Education_Level_Final,
  levels = c("Low education", "Medium education", "High education")
)


# Histogram by Gender
ggplot(data_long, aes(x = Drug, fill = Use_Status)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Gender) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("User" = "#E9006D", "Non-User" = "#BCB8F0")  # custom colors
  ) +
  labs(title = "Drug Use by Gender",
       x = "Drug Type", y = "Number of Individuals", fill = "Use Status") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Histogram by Education
ggplot(data_long, aes(x = Drug, fill = Use_Status)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Education_Level_Final) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("User" = "#E9006D", "Non-User" = "#BCB8F0")  # custom colors
  ) +
  labs(title = "Drug Use by Education Level",
       x = "Drug Type", y = "Number of Individuals",
       fill = "Use Status") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Histogram by Age Group
ggplot(data_long, aes(x = Drug, fill = Use_Status)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Age_Group) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("User" = "#E9006D", "Non-User" = "#BCB8F0")  # custom colors
  ) +
  labs(title = "Drug Use by Age Group",
       x = "Drug Type", y = "Number of Individuals",  fill = "Use Status") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

```{r}

library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(readxl)
library(pheatmap)


ddata <- read_excel("CLEANING DATA DRUG.xlsx", sheet = "DATA_FINAL_ANALYSIS")


personality_traits <- c("Neuroticism","Extraversion","Openness","Agreeableness",
                        "Conscientiousness","Impulsivity","Sensation_Seeking")

drug_cols <- c(
  "Caffeine_Use", "Nicotine_Use", "Alcohol_Use", "Chocolate_Use",
  "Cocaine_Use", "Ketamine_Use", "Heroin_Use", "LSD_Use"
)


pretty_drug_labels <- function(mat) {
  labels <- colnames(mat)
  labels <- gsub("_", " ", labels)
  toupper(labels)
}

make_heat_matrix <- function(df) {
  tab <- df %>%
    count(AgeEdu, Drug, name = "Users") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Drug, values_from = Users, values_fill = 0)
  
  mat <- as.matrix(tab[, -1])
  rownames(mat) <- tab$AgeEdu
  mat
}


ddata_long <- ddata %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(drug_cols),
               names_to = "Drug",
               values_to = "Use_Status") %>%
  mutate(
    Drug = gsub("_Use$", "", Drug),
    Drug_Type = ifelse(Drug %in% c("Caffeine","Nicotine","Alcohol","Chocolate"),
                       "Legal", "Illegal")
  )

# Add Age+Education column for heatmap
d_long <- ddata_long %>%
  mutate(AgeEdu = paste(Age_Group, Education_Level_Final, sep = "_"))

# Heatmap matrices
mat_all    <- make_heat_matrix(d_long)
mat_male   <- make_heat_matrix(filter(d_long, Gender == "Male"))
mat_female <- make_heat_matrix(filter(d_long, Gender == "Female"))

# Color palettes
overall_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#FFFFFF", "#b38bff"))(100)
male_colors    <- colorRampPalette(c("#FFFFFF", "#6bb6ff"))(100)
female_colors  <- colorRampPalette(c("#FFFFFF", "#ff8ac6"))(100)


dist_choices <- c(
  "Gender" = "Gender",
  "Age Group" = "Age_Group",
  "Education Level" = "Education_Level_Final"
)

facet_choices <- c(
  "Gender" = "Gender",
  "Age Group" = "Age_Group",
  "Education Level" = "Education_Level_Final"
)


# UI

ui <- dashboardPage(
  skin = "black",
  
  dashboardHeader(
    title = tags$div(
      style="background: linear-gradient(to right, #E9006D, #BCB8F0);
             padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 16px; white-space: normal;",
      "Drug Use & Personality Dashboard"
    )
  ),
  
  dashboardSidebar(
    sidebarMenu(
      menuItem("Data Distribution", tabName = "overview", icon = icon("chart-pie")),
      menuItem("Histogram", tabName = "hist", icon = icon("chart-bar")),
      menuItem("Boxplot", tabName = "box", icon = icon("box")),
      menuItem("Heatmaps", tabName = "heat", icon = icon("th"))
    ),
    hr(),
    h4("Histogram Controls"),
    selectInput("facet_var", "Facet by:",
                choices = facet_choices,
                selected = "Gender"),
    checkboxGroupInput("drug_type_filter_hist", "Drug Type:",
                       choices = c("Legal","Illegal"), selected = c("Legal","Illegal")),
    hr(),
    h4("Boxplot Controls"),
    selectInput("trait", "Personality Trait:", choices = personality_traits, selected = personality_traits[1]),
    checkboxGroupInput("drug_type_filter_box", "Drug Type:",
                       choices = c("Legal","Illegal"), selected = c("Legal","Illegal"))
  ),
  
  dashboardBody(
    tabItems(
      
      #  OVERVIEW 
      tabItem(tabName = "overview",
              fluidRow(
                valueBoxOutput("total_users"),
                valueBoxOutput("total_nonusers"),
                valueBoxOutput("total_drugs")
              ),
              fluidRow(
                box(title = "Distribution Selector", width = 4, status = "primary", solidHeader = TRUE,
                    selectInput("dist_var", "Choose variable:", 
                                choices = dist_choices, selected = "Gender")
                ),
                box(title = "Pie Chart", width = 8, status = "info", solidHeader = TRUE,
                    plotlyOutput("pie_dist", height = "350px")
                )
              ),
              fluidRow(
                box(title = "Distribution Barplot", width = 12, status = "primary", solidHeader = TRUE,
                    plotlyOutput("dist_bar", height = "400px")
                )
              )
      ),
      
      #  HISTOGRAM 
      tabItem(tabName = "hist",
              fluidRow(
                box(title="Drug Use Histogram", width=12, status="primary",
                    solidHeader=TRUE, plotlyOutput("hist_plot"))
              )
      ),
      
      #  BOXPLOT 
      tabItem(tabName = "box",
              fluidRow(
                box(title="Personality Traits Boxplot", width=12, status="primary",
                    solidHeader=TRUE, plotlyOutput("box_plot"))
              )
      ),
      
      #  HEATMAPS 
      tabItem(tabName = "heat",
              fluidRow(
                box(title="Overall Heatmap", width=12, status="primary",
                    solidHeader=TRUE, plotOutput("heat_all", height="600px"))
              ),
              fluidRow(
                box(title="Male Heatmap", width=12, status="info",
                    solidHeader=TRUE, plotOutput("heat_male", height="600px"))
              ),
              fluidRow(
                box(title="Female Heatmap", width=12, status="warning",
                    solidHeader=TRUE, plotOutput("heat_female", height="600px"))
              )
      )
    )
  )
)


# SERVER
server <- function(input, output) {
  
  # Value boxes
  output$total_users <- renderValueBox({
    n_users <- sum(ddata_long$Use_Status %in% c("User","user","Yes","1"), na.rm = TRUE)
    valueBox(n_users, "TOTAL USERS", icon = icon("users"), color = "fuchsia")
  })
  
  output$total_nonusers <- renderValueBox({
    n_non <- sum(!ddata_long$Use_Status %in% c("User","user","Yes","1") & !is.na(ddata_long$Use_Status), na.rm = TRUE)
    valueBox(n_non, "TOTAL NON-USERS", icon = icon("user-slash"), color = "blue")
  })
  
  output$total_drugs <- renderValueBox({
    valueBox(length(unique(ddata_long$Drug)), "TOTAL DRUG TYPES", icon = icon("pills"), color = "purple")
  })
  
  #  PIE CHART / BAR CHART 
 output$dist_bar <- renderPlotly({
  df <- ddata %>%
    count(.data[[input$dist_var]]) %>%
    rename(category = 1, n = n)
  
  plot_title <- paste("Distribution of", gsub("_", " ", input$dist_var))
  
  # Define custom colors (adjust to match the number of categories)
  my_colors <- c("#ff8ac6", "#6bb6ff", "#b38bff", "darkgreen", "orange", "red")
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(category, -n), y = n, fill = category)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
    labs(x = gsub("_", " ", input$dist_var), y = "Count", title = plot_title) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  ggplotly(p)
})


output$pie_dist <- renderPlotly({
  df <- ddata %>%
    count(.data[[input$dist_var]]) %>%
    rename(category = 1, n = n)
  
  plot_title <- paste("Pie of", gsub("_", " ", input$dist_var))
  
  # Define custom colors
  my_colors <- c("#ff8ac6", "#6bb6ff", "#b38bff", "darkgreen", "orange", "red")  # add as many as needed
  
  plot_ly(df, labels = ~category, values = ~n, type = "pie",
          textinfo = "label+percent", insidetextorientation = "radial",
          marker = list(colors = my_colors)) %>%
    layout(title = plot_title)
})

  
  #  HISTOGRAM 
  filtered_hist <- reactive({
    ddata_long %>% filter(Drug_Type %in% input$drug_type_filter_hist)
  })
  
 output$hist_plot <- renderPlotly({
  df <- filtered_hist()
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=Drug, fill=Use_Status)) +
    geom_bar(position="dodge", color="black") +
    facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", input$facet_var))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("User"="#E9006D","Non-User"="#BCB8F0")) +
    theme_minimal(14) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) +
    labs(x = "Drug", y = "Count")   # <-- Capital C here
  ggplotly(p)
})

  
  #  BOXPLOT 
  filtered_box <- reactive({
    ddata_long %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(personality_traits),
                   names_to = "Trait", values_to = "Score") %>%
      mutate(Usage = Use_Status, Category = Drug_Type) %>%
      filter(Trait == input$trait, Category %in% input$drug_type_filter_box)
  })
  
  output$box_plot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- filtered_box() %>% mutate(Score = as.numeric(Score))
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=Usage, y=Score, fill=Usage)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      facet_wrap(~Category) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=c("User"="#E9006D","Non-User"="#BCB8F0")) +
      theme_minimal(14)
    ggplotly(p)
  })
  
#  HEATMAPS
# Precompute pheatmap objects
heat_all_obj <- pheatmap(mat_all, cluster_rows=FALSE, cluster_cols=FALSE,
                         labels_col=pretty_drug_labels(mat_all), color=overall_colors,
                         angle_col=0, silent=TRUE)

heat_male_obj <- pheatmap(mat_male, cluster_rows=FALSE, cluster_cols=FALSE,
                          labels_col=pretty_drug_labels(mat_male), color=male_colors,
                          angle_col=0, silent=TRUE)

heat_female_obj <- pheatmap(mat_female, cluster_rows=FALSE, cluster_cols=FALSE,
                            labels_col=pretty_drug_labels(mat_female), color=female_colors,
                            angle_col=0, silent=TRUE)

output$heat_all <- renderPlot({
  grid::grid.draw(heat_all_obj$gtable)
})

output$heat_male <- renderPlot({
  grid::grid.draw(heat_male_obj$gtable)
})

output$heat_female <- renderPlot({
  grid::grid.draw(heat_female_obj$gtable)
})

  
}


# RUN APP

shinyApp(ui, server)

```
